/bin/bash -c "git diff -- package.json; cat package.json; rg -n 'prefers-reduced-motion|::view-transition' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md; rg -n 'prefers-reduced-motion' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides | head -15"
/bin/bash -c "sed -n '352,390p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md; ls -l node_modules/.bin/tsc node_modules/.bin/next; git diff -- app/page.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx"

/bin/bash -c "git status --short && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- tsconfig.json package.json app/PageTransition.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx app/page.tsx 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' | head -235 && command -v chromium || command -v google-chrome || true"
/bin/bash -c "cat .gitignore; cat next-env.d.ts; cat tsconfig.json; ls -la __agent_eval__; sed -n '1,70p' package-lock.json"

/bin/bash -c 'for path in / /product/classic-sneakers /product/does-not-exist; do echo "$path"; curl -s -o /tmp/gallery-response.html -w '"'%{http_code} %{size_download}\\n' \"http://localhost:3100"'$path"; rg -o '"'Classic Sneakers|Back to products|Products|page could not be found' /tmp/gallery-response.html | head -8; done"
